verification: Every record verified live via YouTube oEmbed (title + author resolved) on 2026-11-13; no unverified video is embedded. Source type is labelled honestly — NASA-official vs institutional vs independent educator.
note: These are curated educational/research videos chosen for direct topical relevance to each investigation; they are NOT NASA experimental footage unless labelled so. Fire Science Show episode 221 (SoFIE/MIST, Prof. Michael Gollner) is linked as an external resource, not embedded.

videos.title: Why Fires In Space Are So Dangerous
videos.overview: Accessible explanation of why flames behave differently in microgravity — spherical diffusion flames, no buoyant plume — the exact physics regime of the PSI corpus. Good orientation for non-specialists.

videos.title: Understanding Cool Flames and Warm Flames — Yiguang Ju
videos.overview: Combustion Institute lecture on cool-flame chemistry and limits — directly the science of CFI (droplet cool flames) and CFI-G (gaseous cool flames, up to 85% O₂ at the burner), including two-stage ignition and extinction physics.

videos.title: High Pressure Combustion in Microgravity using Biofuel — Ziaul Rizal
videos.channel: AITC Mission Integration (Land Grant Seminar Series)
videos.overview: Research seminar on droplet-scale microgravity combustion at elevated pressure — methodologically adjacent to FLEX/FLEX-2 droplet extinction studies (pressure and diluent sweeps on isolated droplets).

videos.title: Master Class: Flame Fundamentals
videos.overview: Flame fundamentals — stoichiometry, flame structure, soot and luminosity — the theoretical background behind the SPICE smoke-point investigation and the equation registry's combustion section.

videos.title: Combustion Physics, Law, Day 1, Part 1
videos.overview: Prof. Chung Law's combustion physics lectures — the same framework (droplet burning, flammability limits, extinction) that underlies the FLEX-family analyses and the project's verified equation sources.

videos.title: Webinar #6 Physical Science: Fluid Dynamics (AccSpace4All Hypergravity/Microgravity Series)
videos.channel: UN Office for Outer Space Affairs
videos.overview: UNOOSA webinar on microgravity physical-science research — programme context for why fluids/combustion experiments run on orbiting laboratories and how the results transfer (or do not) to partial gravity.

externalResources.title: Fire Science Show #221 — Fire experiments at the ISS: SoFIE & MIST with Michael Gollner
externalResources.overview: Episode with a SoFIE co-investigator on solid-fuel ignition and extinction aboard the ISS — external listening resource for the SoFIE research gap (SoFIE data not yet in PSI).
